title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #01 (세로 띠·매끈 | 인어비늘+스테인드글라스+나비날개비늘+코이비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Vietnamese woman, an adult, in her early 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, warm honey-blonde hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real pores, real living eyes, 100 bars piercings set with rubies in copper-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold a ring. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 25% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 45% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 67% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
